# A Message to the People of Oakland
### From Brenda Grisham, Candidate for Oakland Mayor 2026
To the People of Oakland,
Oakland is more than a city—it is our home. It is where we raise our families, build our businesses, pursue our dreams, and stand together through both challenges and triumphs. I am running for Mayor because I believe in Oakland and the people who make this city strong.
For too long, many residents have felt unheard, overlooked, and frustrated by a lack of accountability from City Hall. Our neighborhoods deserve better. Our families deserve to feel safe. Our businesses deserve the support they need to thrive. And our communities deserve leadership that listens, acts, and delivers results.
My commitment to you is simple: I will put Oakland residents first.
I will work tirelessly to improve public safety, support economic growth, strengthen neighborhood services, and ensure transparency in how your tax dollars are spent. I believe that government works best when it is responsive to the people it serves and accountable for the promises it makes.
This campaign is not about politics as usual. It is about the people, the fight for our neighborhoods, and the future of Oakland. Real change happens when neighbors come together, listen to one another, and work toward common solutions. That is the kind of leadership I will bring to City Hall.
Oakland's greatest strength has always been its people—our resilience, our diversity, our creativity, and our determination to overcome obstacles. Together, we can build a city that is safer, cleaner, more prosperous, and filled with opportunity for every resident.
I ask for your support, your voice, and your vote on November 3, 2026.
Let us move Oakland forward—together.
With gratitude and determination,
Brenda Grisham
Candidate for Oakland Mayor 2026
"From the soil of Oakland, for the people of Oakland."

I am proud to wholeheartedly endorse Brenda Grisham for Mayor of Oakland in the 2026 election. For years, Brenda has been on the front lines of our community — organizing, advocating, and standing up for the people when it mattered most. This isn’t someone who just showed up during election season. This is a true community activist who has consistently fought for our neighborhoods and worked to make Oakland stronger. As we approach the elections of 2026, our city is at a turning point. We need leadership rooted in action, not just promises. Brenda understands the concerns of everyday residents because she has been in the community listening, building relationships, and pushing for solutions that uplift families, protect small businesses, and create opportunities for our youth. Oakland deserves a mayor who leads with integrity, accountability, and heart. In 2026, I am proud to stand with Brenda Grisham because I believe in her commitment to putting people first and moving our city forward together.
Eid Abdel
Town Cuts Barbershop LLC
I am proud to Endorse my Friend and Candidate for Mayor. I have known Brenda Grisham for many years and have personally witnessed the dedication, leadership, and genuine care shown towards our community.
Brenda is a person of integrity who understands the needs of everyday people. Brenda believes in creating safer neighborhoods, supporting local businesses, proving community service, and bringing people together to create positive change. What stands out most is Brenda’s willingness to listen, work hard, and put the community first. Our city deserves leadership that is honest, compassionate, and committed to progress. I truly believe Brenda has the vision and experience needed to move our community forward in a positive direction. I encourage everyone to support and vote for Brenda Grisham for Mayor. Together we can build a stronger and brighter future for our city.
Sincerely,
Priscilla Bellard Hodge.
